title: Time passes regardless: build something to show for the next 10 years
summary: A one-minute mindset essay arguing that the next decade will pass whether or not you act, so you should deliberately pursue mastery (a skill, a business, an achievement) to have something to show for it. It is a motivational prompt with no tactical growth or marketing content.

principles.text: Time passes regardless of effort, so the only choice is whether you have something to show for it.
principles.quote: The years will pass no matter what — it’s up to you to have something to show for them.

principles.text: Commit to a long-horizon pursuit now (a craft, business, or achievement) since you'll be ten years older anyway.
principles.quote: You might as well be a business owner.
